scope: Four fixed offscreen editor renders of the saved additive EnvTest scene with its own night RenderSettings. Camera.scene restricts culling; previous active scene is restored and never saved. No runtime frame-time measurement or gameplay validation.
isolationCaveat: Saved EnvTest was opened additively and made active for its RenderSettings; camera.scene restricted rendering to it. Other scenes were neither saved nor played. Complete exclusion of other-scene realtime-light influence was not independently measured.
